given_when_then.given: A Delivery Proof is successfully recorded for an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The system processes the settlement event
given_when_then.then: The system updates the status of the Order Request to 'Settled' and generates a Financial Transaction Record

given_when_then.given: The Delivery Proof is missing or invalid for an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to process the settlement event
given_when_then.then: The system does not update the Order Request status to 'Settled' and flags the Order Request for manual review

given_when_then.given: The system detects high-risk indicators on the Financial Transaction Record
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to process the settlement event
given_when_then.then: The system pauses the financial distribution and prevents the status from changing to 'Settled' until manual verification is completed

given_when_then.given: The system processes a completed delivery for an Order Request
given_when_then.then: The sum of all distributed amounts in the Financial Transaction Record equals the total value of the Financial Transaction Record

success_criteria: The Order Request status must be updated to 'Settled' only after a valid Delivery Proof is recorded.
The status must not change to 'Settled' if the Delivery Proof is missing or invalid.
The status must not change to 'Setteld' if high-risk indicators are present.
The sum of all distributed amounts must equal the total value of the Financial Transaction Record.
A Financial Transaction Record must be generated for every completed delivery regardless of outcome.
The distribution amounts must adhere to the terms defined in the Store Partner Agreement.
